decision: Approve the unique-labelled 110-node CAVIAR_FULL matrix for static directed analysis only.

evidence.supports: The archive supplies 11 phase matrices and one 110-by-110 complete person-by-person matrix; ties are directed, valued communication exchanges from police wiretapping.
Section 3.1 states that all CAVIAR networks are directed and weighted and that link direction points from caller to receiver.

source_label_integrity.full_static_matrix: passed: CAVIAR_FULL has 110 unique row/column labels
source_label_integrity.phase_series: not approved for directed processing: CAVIAR7 repeats actor label 9 at positions 9 and 15 in both the CSV and paired UCINET header

scope_limitations: No phase-specific or temporal directed analysis is permitted from the current source representation.
The CAVIAR7 duplicate-label defect is preserved and not imputed, merged, or silently renamed.
The approved full matrix supports static dyadic arc, footprint, formal-concept, and dyadic-role targets only; it supplies no native events.
